entity: Kansas Forestry, Fish and Game Commission
summary: The Kansas Forestry, Fish and Game Commission finds Executive Order 11644 compatible with its own objectives, activities, and comprehensive land management planning. The Commission acknowledges that the problems addressed by the Order exist at the state level as well, and indicates it plans to alter its own regulations to impose similar controls over off-road vehicles on state lands. It views the federal action as supportive of state-level efforts to manage ORV use.

statement.text:
Executive Order 11644, though confined to regulation of off-road vehicles
on certain Department of the Interior and Department of Agriculture lands,
is compatible with objectives, activities and comprehensive planning
related to land management by the Kansas Forestry, Fish and Game Commission.
This Order addresses itself to problems common to Federal and State juris-
dictions. The Kansas Forestry, Fish and Game Commission has recognized
these problems at the state level and proposes to alter its regulations
to effect similar controls over its lands. Federal action will serve to
support the imposition, acceptance and control of off-road vehicles on
state jurisdictions
